macro.title: Airbnb Hosts Are Furious They Can No Longer Make Guests Do Their Chores - WIRED
macro.summary: Some hosts are threatening to strike, while others are plotting ways around Airbnb’s new restrictions. Guests, meanwhile, are celebrating.
